# Dirty Kitchen Rave

> Dirty Kitchen Rave (DKR) is a multi-genre bass label from London, run by Afghan Headspin. It releases breaks, UK bass, UK garage, bassline, rave, jungle, drum & bass, breakbeat, dubstep and disco.

The website is bilingual. English lives under /en and Spanish under /es. English is the default language.

## Pages

- /en — home, latest drop
- /en/releases — full catalogue, newest first
- /en/artists — artists with a release or remix on the label
- /en/genres — genres, each with its own catalogue page
- /en/shop — official clothing, vinyl and the digital catalogue
- /en/demos — demo submissions, received only through LabelRadar
- /en/about — the label
- /en/podcast — the Dirty Kitchen Rave podcast
- /en/links — link-in-bio (Beatport, Bandcamp, socials, merch)

The same paths exist in Spanish under /es.
